en: A black‑and‑white historic streetscape showing a corner building with ornate late‑19th‑century architecture on an unpaved intersection. The three‑storey structure has a decorated roofline with finials and a central dome‑like feature. Signs on the façade advertise a bakery and confectionery, a tailor (Herrenschneider), and the name Robert Lankow. A man rides a bicycle on the dirt road, and a woman walks along the fenced sidewalk. Trees and similarly styled townhouses line the street; a church spire is visible in the distant left background.
